content: Clerk App Router quickstart: npx clerk@latest init writes publishable/secret keys to .env.local; proxy.ts (Next 16+) or middleware.ts (Next <=15) exports clerkMiddleware(); ClerkProvider wraps root layout; auth() is an async helper usable in Server Components/Actions/Route Handlers, exposing isAuthenticated. Cross-checked via WebSearch snippet and a direct WebFetch of clerk.com's quickstart page.
